title: One-step transition test
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean-valued tapes, let $c,B,e$ be natural numbers, let $b$ be a Boolean, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. The test returns true exactly when the nested pair encoding obtained from the indicated first and second projections of $z$ belongs to the one-step language of $N$ with its coin fixed to $b$.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Bool
c, B, and e are natural numbers
caveat: The payload does not include definitions of the pair projections, pair encoding, fixed-coin machine, or one-step language.
